notes.title: 2024/6/1 Description of the update V 2.02
notes.notes:
1. Players can now choose to return to the save point directly from the Settings menu.
2. Added some guidance.
3. Fixed some translation issues.
4. Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Add checkpoint (Save point) function Version 2.00
notes.notes:
1. The game has now added a checkpoint function, when the player plays a non-final ending, he can restart from the previous checkpoint, instead of starting the whole round again.
2. A dimly-lit scene adds brightness
3. Camera's shaking amplitude is changed to 70%
4. Added more guidance.
5. Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Subsequent update notice-checkpoint ( save point)
notes.notes: After receiving feedback from players, we decided to make a checkpoint function, which is under development to make it easier for players to play all endings faster.
